summary: Master ESG ratings, investor relations and disclosure strategy with practical tools, investor-ready templates, and hands-on reporting exercises.
lede: ESG ratings and disclosure strategy training helps ESG and investor-relations professionals structure a controlled reporting process. Learners assess rating drivers, map disclosures to supporting evidence, and prepare investor briefings and Q&A. Workshops also cover disclosure controls, limited assurance readiness, and planning improvements around data and budget constraints.
audienceIntro: This course is designed for professionals who already touch ESG data, investor communications, or governance reporting and need a more disciplined disclosure strategy.
outcomes: ESG Framework Alignment (GRI, SASB, ISSB, TCFD)
prerequisites: You need a laptop, familiarity with basic ESG or reporting documents, and access to a recent sustainability report or investor presentation if available. If your organization uses an ESG data collection template, disclosure tracker, or board pack format, bring it for workshop application.
